chunks: The example of those who disbelieve is like one who calls out to what hears nothing except a call and a cry; deaf, dumb and blind, so they do not understand.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the simile of the shepherd in Surah Al-Baqarah regarding disbelievers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (2:171) is often interpreted as describing the state of those who follow leaders without understanding, likening their blind imitation to livestock responding to a mere call. The triad of deafness, dumbness, and blindness symbolizes a spiritual paralysis where the heart is sealed against divine truth, rendering them incapable of rational reflection (ta'aqqul). This imagery underscores the distinction between mere auditory perception and true intellectual and spiritual comprehension.
